events.visible: first released PLY leaf-semantic nonnegative temporal instance observation; first scan is left-censored
events.segmentable: first strict IoU>0.5 match in the frozen S2 predictions; model-dependent operational proxy, not intrinsic segmentability
events.trackable: first of three consecutive matched observations with the same frozen TrackPlant3D track; retrospective benchmark annotation only
events.right_censoring: never segmentable/trackable is missing, not the last scan
events.evaluation: exact current-scan event matching by strict mask IoU>0.5; first scan excluded; no biological birth claim
events.area: official measured leaf area at first PLY observation, cm2, evaluation only
events.core_adjacent: GT leaf-to-core point distance p10<=0.005m, evaluation proxy only

causality.padding: repeat earliest available scan with explicit availability and actual DAS gaps
causality.forecast: separate one-step plant event prediction using only frames <=t, target next scheduled scan

birth_training.selection: mean of three seed plant-macro exact-event F1 on Validation; deterministic tie higher threshold

tracking_training.selection: mean three-seed Validation plant IDF1; higher threshold tie

system_selection: select birth detector and C1/C2 using Validation only; force selected explicit birth regions to new tracks; select maximum mean plant birth F1 among systems with mean IDF1>=imported B0, otherwise report best identity system without claiming birth success

decision.A: BIRTH-SUCCESS if all birth gates pass
decision.B: otherwise TRACKING-SUCCESS if paired IDF1 lower CI>0 and mean delta>=0.02 and correct-link coverage delta>=0.02
decision.C: otherwise DATA-LIMITED: bounded models do not establish stable useful improvement; describe actual event scarcity, interval uncertainty, candidate identifiability and annotation limitations, not a proof of universal data insufficiency

measurement.oracle: GT masks and GT identities, evaluator only
measurement.perform_if: at least one locked A/B success gate; otherwise descriptive failure/coverage audit only, no claimed reliable recovery

test: already reused exploratory fixed replication; no threshold, architecture, seed or model selection; run three seeds only after Validation selection
historical: reuse M6B B3 and oracle outputs; never rerun, overwrite or retune old methods
